actual_counts.note: Actual normalized byte counts (card vs complete packet, per profile) are reported by the xtask from live card assembly; this file pins the profile set and the relations the ratification depends on, so a regression that embeds the packet envelope, breaks packet routing, or exceeds a default bound fails the report gate. The card-vs-packet size comparison is reported per profile (card_bytes_below_packet_bytes, packet_over_card_percent) but is not a ratification relation: on these single-seam profiles the compact card wire is not smaller than the single-seam packet wire.
